name: Healer
about: Keeps the party going. Energy refills on its own. Drains the life of crowds and bosses to heal the party.

E.name: Mending Vow
E.about: Put a vow on the party member nearest the mouse. When they get hit it heals them, then jumps to another party member. 1 jump, +1 per rank.

F.name: Life Drain
F.about: Toggle. Drains life from every enemy around you and heals the party. Bigger enemy life = bigger drain (a crowd of trash or one big boss).
